name: Ministry Blast Doors
description: Under a ministry building, an old Cold War bunker hums with new hardware. The third password sits behind its blast doors. Drop down the courtyard hatch and descend three tiers. On each one, blast through the guarded corridor, or crawl the air vent above it, fetching USB keys, hacking computers and switching off lasers. Wear the goggles in the vault to see the hidden steps to the password.
